_doc: THE single canonical gameplay tunables source (MAHWORLD_GAMEPLAY_CANON.md section 11). Every value here is CANON_TUNABLE: the design is established, the number is configurable. Values come from the human-directed gameplay notes 2026-09-13; nothing is invented. Do not restate these numbers in code or in other documents - reference the key.

fingertip_stabilization_relative_power.rule: clearly weaker than the central lower propulsion; exact fraction OPEN_DECISION (OD-16)

posture_forward: hips visibly flexed into forward travel posture
arms slightly extended behind the body
central lower taper produces propulsion (not a foot)
posture_backward: slight backward hinge / lean, as if falling backward but catching the motion
primary lower-tip propulsion shifts the character backward

split.gait: human-readable leg gait; tips never make heel/toe ground contact; each tip fires a small MAHGIC propulsion pulse in the gait cycle

flight.combat_override_rule: during any combat engagement, regardless of form, flight is capped at combat_max_height_ft above the combat surface; travel ceilings never apply inside combat

idle.aura: tiny subtle MAHGIC aura near fingertips / fingernails

tick_damage_relative_to_main.rule: eccentric tail deals LESS than the main concentric damage; exact ratio OPEN_DECISION (OD-18)

_derived_note: mph -> engine units for mahloco (runtime_config.default.json speed_* placeholders) is a mapping step owned by a later phase; mahloco is not modified by the gameplay foundation.
